description:
Personal finance for Mac, built around how you actually spend.

WiseBudgeter pulls your transactions in automatically, tracks every currency you touch, and gives you a clear monthly picture — without spreadsheets, subscriptions, or ads.

Automatic Bank Sync
Connect Wise and Monobank to import transactions on demand or let the app sync automatically on launch. Smart categorization based on merchant and MCC codes. Duplicates are detected and skipped, so your records stay clean.

Multi-Currency, Done Right
Move between UAH, PLN, EUR, USD or any combination. Every transaction is stored in both its original currency and your base currency, using real-time Wise exchange rates.

Budget Planning & Pacing
Set monthly budgets per category and watch a live pacing bar tell you whether you're on track — not just at month-end, but day by day.

Cashflow & Lifetime View
See income vs expenses month by month, then zoom out to a Lifetime view that shows every year you've tracked at a glance.

Apple Intelligence Insights
Get on-device spending insights generated by Apple Intelligence — no data leaves your Mac. Or hand off the month's data to Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini with one click for a deeper analysis.

Built for Mac
Native SwiftUI, fast, and quiet. Bank credentials live in your Keychain. Your data stays on your device. No subscriptions, no ads, no telemetry — just a tool for managing your money.

Import & Export
CSV import for Wise, Monobank, and the app's own format. Export any month or your entire history for backup.

Download WiseBudgeter and see exactly where your money goes — in every currency you use.
promotionalText: A refreshed look and more reliable bank sync — see what's new in this update.
whatsNew:
Thank you for using WiseBudgeter!

This update gives the transaction form and Budget Plan a cleaner, more polished look. Bank sync is also more reliable: syncs now resume from where they left off instead of rechecking already-synced months, and a new sidebar indicator lets you know right away if a sync run fails.
